caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical vehicle rendered in shades of gray and black with fine line detailing. The vehicle has three large, spoked wheels—two at the rear and one at the front—each depicted in a side view. The central structure of the vehicle contains a vertically oriented, cylindrical boiler with an angled top and a small protruding lever or handle on its side. Attached to the boiler are various mechanical components, including pipes and levers, oriented around the middle of the composition. The front section of the vehicle features a platform with a framework seat made of thin rods, possibly metal, and a steering mechanism resembling thin levers. The overall design is open, with no outer body panels, exposing structural supports, cylindrical tanks, and rods. The drawing is set against a plain, light background, and is labeled with the scale "One inch to one foot" in small black letters at the lower left, and the name "Harry G. Aberdeen" in the lower right.
title: Iron Steam Fire Engine
